assertion: November recorded the highest daily average, with 27.3 fatal crashes occurring around sunset. This was 43.4% above January's average of 19.0.

During the two hours following sunset, 543 fatal crashes were recorded, compared with 276 during the preceding two hours. The post-sunset figure was 96.7% higher. The four-hour window accounted for 26.9% of November's matched fatal crashes, compared with 21.0% in July. January recorded the highest proportion of crashes occurring after sunset within the window, at 72.2%.

Across 2024, researchers identified 8,334 fatal crashes and 8,921 deaths within the four-hour sunset period. Nationally, the number of fatal crashes during the two hours after sunset was 57.8% higher than during the two hours before sunset.
